title: One Brief, Many Vendors
text: Describe what you need once. We introduce it to suitable packaging vendors, instead of you chasing dozens of separate suppliers.

title: Matched to the Merchant
text: Sizes, materials and print are specified per merchant, so a pizzeria and a burger joint never end up with the same box.

title: Specified Around the Food
text: We start from how the packaging will be used — heat, grease, stacking and delivery — and shape the brief so vendors quote the right thing.

title: A Single Point of Contact
text: The Pack Up sits in the middle, keeping requirements clear while you deal directly with the vendors who produce, price and deliver.

title: Every Packaging Category
text: Food packaging first, with cartons, bakery, retail and custom-branded packaging available through the same network.
